protocol.order: managed then direct in each pair; order effect not eliminated
protocol.corpus: one scratch alpha.py: def greet(name): return hello + name; diagnostic only
protocol.setup: fresh isolated artifact store/runtime/HOME; prepare and sync once before pairs
protocol.transport: same captured --args-file contents and same argv except ephemeral filename; same replacement seven-key environment and cwd
protocol.cache: new namespace/index at setup; reused between pairs; no OS cache eviction; OS cache state UNKNOWN
protocol.instrumentation: nested Python spans with absolute monotonic and UTC timestamps; inclusive durations never summed
protocol.resource: Python CPU and RUSAGE_CHILDREN only; incomplete detached descendant coverage
protocol.failures: retain completed samples and failure information; no silent rerun; changed protocol requires new run id
protocol.exclusive_slot: main commit first; halt tests/builds before timing; explicit coordinator grant required
protocol.inventory: Untimed before/after each pair and finally: bounded ps pid/ppid/pgid/comm; lsof +D scratch; <=256 scratch lstat entries. Partial observations, not proof of absence; process and socket lifetime UNKNOWN.
protocol.source_identity: Untimed hashes of every non-symlink src/sot_graph/*.py recursively, bounded git HEAD/status receipts.
protocol.failure_receipts: failure.json catches every exception after output mkdir, including initialization; traceback and scratch leftover inventory. Later failures also diagnostic-result.json. Early failure context binds sanitized explicit invocation fields: output_dir,binary,sha256,native_commit,protocol,registry,slot,samples; supplied digest is expected identity, not a false verification claim.
protocol.python_configuration: LANG/LC_ALL/TZ/PYTHONMALLOC/PYTHONHASHSEED/PYTHONWARNINGS allowlist; known-safe sys._xoptions values and names only.
protocol.scratch_durability: Scratch remains ephemeral /tmp to preserve short native socket paths; durable result copies inventories and cache hashes; no global process cleanup.

acceptance.measurement: at least three successful paired samples with matching artifact/env/timeout/transport and timestamps
acceptance.attribution: post-run independent review identifies measured dominant cost and specific safe fix, else INCONCLUSIVE with missing evidence
acceptance.m2: not authorized by successful runner exit; requires attributable bottleneck evidence
acceptance.performance_gate: not G6 benchmark; no PASS or improvement claim from this microdiagnostic

known_gaps: Native startup/query/teardown boundaries not directly instrumented.
Bounded point-in-time inventory cannot establish full daemon lifetime, transient listeners, escaped descendants, or absence of leftovers.
Historical 26.7426s environment/cache state not reproduced; no causal explanation assumed.
Pair order fixed; only one tiny Python corpus; no representative language/task conclusions.
Hardware preflight is local only; no remote platform evidence.
rollback: remove only this newly created run directory if uncommitted; retain scratch path reported by measurement; no global cleanup
